create_dataset: create a Dataset instance that loads train, valid, and test splits from pickle or numpy files
subsample_triples: subsample n random entries from a triples tensor using torch randperm
invert_triples_numpy: invert numpy triples to add reciprocal relations by swapping head and tail entities
invert_triples_torch: invert torch triples for validation or test splits by swapping head and tail entities
evaluate_model: evaluate a KBCModel on a dataset split computing MRR and hits at k metrics
